items.stem: A type-ahead search issues an HTTP request per keystroke. Which operator ensures only the latest request's result is used and in-flight older requests are cancelled?

options.rationale: Correct: switchMap unsubscribes from the previous inner observable when a new value arrives.
mergeMap keeps all inner subscriptions, so stale responses can arrive late.
concatMap queues requests in order, delaying the latest result.
exhaustMap ignores new values while one is in flight, dropping newer keystrokes.

items.explanation: Correct: switchMap unsubscribes from the previous inner observable when a new value arrives.

items.stem: Which TWO practices help an Angular app avoid memory and performance problems with RxJS? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Using the async pipe so subscriptions clean up with the component
options.rationale: Correct: the async pipe unsubscribes automatically on destroy.

options.text: Using shareReplay to avoid duplicate HTTP calls for shared data
options.rationale: Correct: shareReplay multicasts one result to many subscribers.

options.text: Manually subscribing in ngOnInit and never unsubscribing
options.rationale: That leaks subscriptions for long-lived streams.

options.text: Calling subscribe inside a template expression
options.rationale: That creates repeated subscriptions on every change detection.

items.explanation: Correct: the async pipe unsubscribes automatically on destroy.

items.stem: *ngFor re-renders an entire list whenever the array reference changes. What does a correct trackBy function require to help?

options.text: A stable unique identity for each item (such as an id)
options.rationale: Correct: trackBy must return a stable key so Angular can reuse DOM nodes.

options.text: The array index, which is always stable across reorders
options.rationale: Index is not stable when items are reordered or removed.

options.text: A new object per render to force updates
options.rationale: New objects defeat tracking and cause more re-rendering.

options.text: Nothing; trackBy works without a return value
options.rationale: trackBy must return a key to be effective.

items.explanation: Correct: trackBy must return a stable key so Angular can reuse DOM nodes.
